import subprocess,os,select,signal,json,urllib.request,urllib.error,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('test-data/m3');root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p=subprocess.Popen(['target/debug/depot-server'],env={**os.environ,'DEPOT_LISTEN':'127.0.0.1:0','DEPOT_DATA':str(root)},stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
try:
 assert select.select([p.stdout],[],[],10)[0]
 base='http://'+p.stdout.readline().strip().split()[-1]
 def cli(*args):
  r=subprocess.run(['target/debug/depot-cli','--server',base,'--json',*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.returncode,r.stderr)
  return json.loads(r.stdout)
 cli('repo-create','smoke');cli('repo-list')
 source=root/'source.bin';source.write_bytes(bytes(range(256))*16)
 meta=cli('upload','smoke','binary','opaque.1',str(source));assert meta['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert cli('list','smoke')['total']==1
 assert cli('info','smoke','binary','opaque.1')['size']==4096
 dest=root/'download.bin';cli('download','smoke','binary','opaque.1',str(dest));assert dest.read_bytes()==source.read_bytes()
 print(json.dumps({'m3':'passed','sha256':meta['sha256']}))
finally:
 p.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
 try:p.wait(timeout=5)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait(timeout=5)
